name: Blue Magister
description:
You are partially transformed into a spirit of thought and magic, granting yourself incredible arcane power.

  • Your Mind and Soul increase by +2.

  • You gain a Fly Speed of 5. If you already have a Fly Speed, it increases by +5.

  • Once per turn, when you successfully cast a spell, you may immediately cast a second spell as a Free Action. The Complexity of the second spell increases by +1.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.
